scope: A blank recording aid. No invitation, participation, consent, review, public access or successful execution is established by this file.

recording_guidance.review_roles: Record the actual roles: researcher first use, methodology, accessibility. Roles may overlap only when the work and qualifications are recorded.
recording_guidance.status: Keep invited, consented, attempted, completed with assistance, completed without assistance and unable to complete distinct. Preserve earlier states with timestamps in the completed record.
recording_guidance.observed_tasks: For each task record its trigger, expected behavior, actual observation, evidence location and outcome. Do not treat blank fields as passing checks.
recording_guidance.privacy: Do not include credentials, private prompts, model weights or attribution without the person's permission.
recording_guidance.claims: Separate public download, model execution, retained-output reanalysis, accessibility observations and qualified feedback. None implies peer review or a general usability success rate.
